explanation: Two latent divergences. (1) The wording defines a public method as one whose name does not start with an underscore, but m.is_public is also false when the enclosing class name starts with an underscore, so a production connector class such as _YDatabase(SQLDatabase) would lose all its methods. (2) The question asks for one row per (class, method name), but the reference has no DISTINCT; a property getter+setter or any repeated def of the same name in the class body yields two method symbols (the second with an @L suffix) and so duplicate rows; the same happens if class_bases lists SQLDatabase twice for one class. Repeated qualnames do occur in this repo (e.g. _FakeCursor.execute twice in connectors tests). Neither case occurs on the 9 study DBs. Cross-cutting test-code note: the question defines test code as every file under a tests/ folder, and the reference uses files.is_test. On the real DB the two agree exactly. In fuzz variants v0, v1, v3, v4, v5 and v7, study/fuzz.py inserts <existing folder>/fuzz_mod<k>.py with is_test = f.startswith('tests/'), so files such as auto_ontology/connectors/tests/fuzz_mod1.py are under a tests/ folder yet is_test = false (this also contradicts the is_test column description). The corrected SQL uses (is_test OR file_id LIKE 'tests/%' OR file_id LIKE '%/tests/%'); the better repair is to fix fuzz.py so is_test follows the path rule. (No test-path witness for this question either.)
corrected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.class_symbol_id, m.name AS method_name FROM code.class_bases b JOIN code.symbols c ON c.symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = c.file_id JOIN code.symbols m ON m.file_id = c.file_id AND m.kind = 'method' AND m.qualname = c.qualname || '.' || m.name WHERE b.base_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py::SQLDatabase' AND NOT (f.is_test OR f.file_id LIKE 'tests/%' OR f.file_id LIKE '%/tests/%') AND NOT starts_with(m.name, '_') AND m.name NOT IN (SELECT bm.name FROM code.symbols bm WHERE bm.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND bm.kind = 'method' AND bm.qualname LIKE 'SQLDatabase.%') ORDER BY 1, 2
